description: Implementation of the o_du_high_impl class managing DU high-level operations, including starting/stopping DU, configuring interfaces, and handling notifications in a 3GPP-related software system.

classes.name: phy_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of mac_result_notifier that holds references to mac_cell_result_notifier objects and provides access based on cell index.

methods.name: o_du_high_impl::start
methods.description: Starts the DU, configures interfaces, and initiates the E2 agent if present.

methods.name: o_du_high_impl::stop
methods.description: Stops the DU and the E2 agent if present.

methods.name: o_du_high_impl::get_mac_fapi_fastpath_adaptor
methods.description: Returns a reference to the mac_fapi_fastpath_adaptor.

methods.name: o_du_high_impl::get_du_high
methods.description: Returns a reference to the du_high object.

methods.name: o_du_high_impl::set_o_du_high_metrics_notifier
methods.description: Sets the metrics notifier for the DU high.
